// Exact source-double arithmetic, confined to Xiqing open-surface witnesses.
// Rational witnesses describe the rendered plane; height is its least binary64
// upper bound, NOT an inflated plane or a collision tolerance.
const bits=new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(8));
const gcd=(a,b)=>{a=a<0n?-a:a;while(b){const r=a%b;a=b;b=r;}return a;};
function rat(n,d=1n){if(d<0n){n=-n;d=-d;}if(!n)return {n:0n,d:1n};const g=gcd(n,d);return {n:n/g,d:d/g};}
export function exactDouble(x){if(!Number.isFinite(x))throw new TypeError('Finite exact input required');bits.setFloat64(0,x);const u=bits.getBigUint64(0),e=Number((u>>52n)&2047n),f=u&((1n<<52n)-1n),n=(u>>63n?-1n:1n)*(e?f+(1n<<52n):f),p=e?e-1075:-1074;return p>=0?rat(n<<BigInt(p)):rat(n,1n<<BigInt(-p));}
const add=(a,b)=>rat(a.n*b.d+b.n*a.d,a.d*b.d),sub=(a,b)=>rat(a.n*b.d-b.n*a.d,a.d*b.d),mul=(a,b)=>rat(a.n*b.n,a.d*b.d),div=(a,b)=>rat(a.n*b.d,a.d*b.n);
export const compareExact=(a,b)=>{const q=a.n*b.d-b.n*a.d;return q<0n?-1:q>0n?1:0;};
function next(x,up){if(x===0)return up?Number.MIN_VALUE:-Number.MIN_VALUE;bits.setFloat64(0,x);bits.setBigUint64(0,bits.getBigUint64(0)+(x>0===up?1n:-1n));return bits.getFloat64(0);}
export function ceilingExact(a){let x=Number(a.n)/Number(a.d);if(!Number.isFinite(x))throw new RangeError('Local roof rational outside binary64 conversion range');while(compareExact(exactDouble(x),a)<0)x=next(x,true);while(compareExact(exactDouble(next(x,false)),a)>=0)x=next(x,false);return x;}
const cache=new WeakMap();
function source(q){let v=cache.get(q);if(!v){v=[q.triangle.a,q.triangle.b,q.triangle.c].map(p=>Object.fromEntries(['x','y','z'].map(k=>[k,exactDouble(p[k])])));cache.set(q,v);}return v;}
function clip(v,k,b,sign){const out=[];for(let i=0;i<v.length;i++){const a=v[i],c=v[(i+1)%v.length],da=sub(a[k],b),dc=sub(c[k],b),ia=sign*compareExact(da,{n:0n,d:1n})>=0,ic=sign*compareExact(dc,{n:0n,d:1n})>=0;if(ia)out.push(a);if(ia!==ic){const t=div(da,sub(da,dc));out.push(Object.fromEntries(['x','y','z'].map(axis=>[axis,add(a[axis],mul(sub(c[axis],a[axis]),t))])));}}return out;}
export function exactSquareWitness(q,x0,x1,z0,z1){let v=source(q);for(const[k,b,s]of[['x',x0,1],['x',x1,-1],['z',z0,1],['z',z1,-1]]){v=clip(v,k,exactDouble(b),s);if(!v.length)return null;}return v.reduce((a,b)=>compareExact(a.y,b.y)>0?a:b);}
export const serializeExact=a=>({numerator:String(a.n),denominator:String(a.d)});
const zero={n:0n,d:1n},one={n:1n,d:1n},axisCache=new WeakMap();
const vecSub=(a,b)=>a.map((v,i)=>sub(v,b[i])),dot=(a,b)=>a.reduce((s,v,i)=>add(s,mul(v,b[i])),zero),cross=(a,b)=>[sub(mul(a[1],b[2]),mul(a[2],b[1])),sub(mul(a[2],b[0]),mul(a[0],b[2])),sub(mul(a[0],b[1]),mul(a[1],b[0]))];
function exactAxes(q){let cached=axisCache.get(q);if(cached)return cached;const v=source(q).map(p=>[p.x,p.y,p.z]),o=v[0],edges=[vecSub(v[1],o),vecSub(v[2],v[1]),vecSub(o,v[2])],basis=[[one,zero,zero],[zero,one,zero],[zero,zero,one]],axes=[...basis,cross(edges[0],vecSub(v[2],o)),...edges.flatMap(e=>basis.map(b=>cross(e,b)))];cached={origin:o,axes:axes.map((axis,index)=>({axis,index})).filter(({axis})=>axis.some(v=>v.n!==0n)).map(({axis,index})=>{const p=v.map(v=>dot(vecSub(v,o),axis));return{axis,index,lo:p.reduce((a,b)=>compareExact(a,b)<0?a:b),hi:p.reduce((a,b)=>compareExact(a,b)>0?a:b)};})};axisCache.set(q,cached);return cached;}
function exactProjection(box,origin,axis){const lo=['x','y','z'].map(k=>exactDouble(box.min[k])),hi=['x','y','z'].map(k=>exactDouble(box.max[k]));return{lo:dot(vecSub(axis.map((v,i)=>v.n<0n?hi[i]:lo[i]),origin),axis),hi:dot(vecSub(axis.map((v,i)=>v.n<0n?lo[i]:hi[i]),origin),axis)};}
export function exactSurfaceIntersects(q,box){const {origin,axes}=exactAxes(q);for(const a of axes){const p=exactProjection(box,origin,a.axis);if(compareExact(p.hi,a.lo)<=0||compareExact(p.lo,a.hi)>=0)return false;}return true;}
export function exactSurfaceSweep(q,from,to){const {origin,axes}=exactAxes(q);let enter=zero,leave=one;for(const a of axes){const p=exactProjection(from,origin,a.axis),t=exactProjection(to,origin,a.axis);for(const[g,h]of[[sub(p.hi,a.lo),sub(t.hi,a.lo)],[sub(a.hi,p.lo),sub(a.hi,t.lo)]]){const speed=sub(h,g);if(!speed.n){if(g.n<=0n)return null;continue;}const time=div({n:-g.n,d:g.d},speed);if(speed.n>0n){if(compareExact(time,enter)>0)enter=time;}else if(compareExact(time,leave)<0)leave=time;if(compareExact(enter,leave)>=0)return null;}}if(compareExact(enter,one)>=0||compareExact(leave,zero)<=0)return null;let fraction=ceilingExact(enter);if(compareExact(exactDouble(fraction),enter)>0)fraction=next(fraction,false);return Math.max(0,fraction);}

// Directed binary64 intervals enclose every source subtraction, cross product
// and projection. Only an interval spanning a strict-contact boundary invokes
// rational SAT. No world-distance epsilon is used for accepting penetration.
const iv=x=>[x,x],ia=(a,b)=>[next(a[0]+b[0],false),next(a[1]+b[1],true)],is=(a,b)=>[next(a[0]-b[1],false),next(a[1]-b[0],true)],im=(a,b)=>{const p=[a[0]*b[0],a[0]*b[1],a[1]*b[0],a[1]*b[1]];return[next(Math.min(...p),false),next(Math.max(...p),true)];};
const ivsub=(a,b)=>a.map((v,i)=>is(v,b[i])),ivdot=(a,b)=>a.reduce((s,v,i)=>ia(s,im(v,b[i])),iv(0)),ivcross=(a,b)=>[is(im(a[1],b[2]),im(a[2],b[1])),is(im(a[2],b[0]),im(a[0],b[2])),is(im(a[0],b[1]),im(a[1],b[0]))];
const intervals=new WeakMap();
function intervalAxes(q){let value=intervals.get(q);if(value)return value;const v=[q.triangle.a,q.triangle.b,q.triangle.c].map(p=>[p.x,p.y,p.z].map(iv)),o=v[0],edges=[ivsub(v[1],o),ivsub(v[2],v[1]),ivsub(o,v[2])],basis=[[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0,0,1]].map(v=>v.map(iv));const axes=[...basis,ivcross(edges[0],ivsub(v[2],o)),...edges.flatMap(e=>basis.map(b=>ivcross(e,b)))];const valid=new Set(exactAxes(q).axes.map(a=>a.index));value={origin:o,axes:axes.map((axis,index)=>({axis,index})).filter(({index})=>valid.has(index)).map(({axis})=>{const p=v.map(v=>ivdot(ivsub(v,o),axis));return{axis,lo:[Math.min(...p.map(v=>v[0])),Math.min(...p.map(v=>v[1]))],hi:[Math.max(...p.map(v=>v[0])),Math.max(...p.map(v=>v[1]))]};})};intervals.set(q,value);return value;}
export function intervalSurfaceIntersects(q,box){const {origin,axes}=intervalAxes(q);let uncertain=false;for(const a of axes){let lo=iv(0),hi=iv(0);for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const k=['x','y','z'][i],p=im(is(iv(box.min[k]),origin[i]),a.axis[i]),t=im(is(iv(box.max[k]),origin[i]),a.axis[i]);lo=ia(lo,[Math.min(p[0],t[0]),Math.min(p[1],t[1])]);hi=ia(hi,[Math.max(p[0],t[0]),Math.max(p[1],t[1])]);}if(hi[1]<=a.lo[0]||lo[0]>=a.hi[1])return false;if(!(hi[0]>a.lo[1]&&lo[1]<a.hi[0]))uncertain=true;}return uncertain?null:true;}
